They are indoors in a brightly lit living room with neutral walls and a curtain background. They smile broadly and point towards a large, yellow and white 'Crayon Shin-chan Fruit Cottage' product box which they hold together at chest height. (2) A close-up view focusing on the large product box. The man's hands are visible as they tear through the cardboard packaging seal at the top. The interior reveals multiple smaller white and yellow individual blind boxes stacked inside. The lighting remains bright and even across the entire scene. (3) A sequence of rapid cuts show the man holding up individual plush toys after unboxing them from plastic bags. He presents a series of Crayon Shin-chan plushies dressed in fruit-themed costumes: orange, peach, durian, banana, cantaloupe, and apple. Each toy has distinct colors and textures like fuzzy pink fur or prickly yellow surfaces. (4) The man and woman reappear, smiling and looking into the lens while holding all six revealed plush toys in a cluster between them. The woman makes an excited face with her mouth open, while the man gestures with his chin. The toys are arranged to show all their different fruit hat variations clearly. (5) The plush toys are placed on a white tabletop surface. The camera provides a close-up view, moving across the line of colorful toys. Each Shin-chan character has stylized cartoon eyes and unique fruit-themed headgear, such as a green cantaloupe skin or a yellow banana peel.
